name: Taran

attributes.attribute: like the Celtic thunder god Taranis

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Taran is a Welsh god. He is named once in the Mabinogion. He is taken to be close to the mainland Celtic thunder god Taranis. Few records of Taran have survived.

okr.objective: Describe Taran, a Welsh thunder god.
key_results: Taran is a Welsh god named in the Mabinogion.
He is held to be like the Celtic thunder god Taranis.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
